news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.95 (vs ₹0.92 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.95 (up from ₹0.92 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹99.7m (up 20% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹3.23m (up ₹6.35m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.2% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 77% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 67% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.70 (vs ₹0.014 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.70 (up from ₹0.014 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹89.2m (up 10.0% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹5.79m (up ₹5.74m from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 6.5% (up from 0.1% in 2Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 72% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 71% per year.
